divisions.quote: The adult human skeleton usually consists of 206 named bones. These bones can be grouped in two divisions: axial skeleton and appendicular skeleton.

types.quote: Long bones include bones of the thigh, leg, arm, and forearm.
Short bones are roughly cube shaped with vertical and horizontal dimensions approximately equal.
Flat bones are thin, flattened, and usually curved.

Bones that are not in any of the above three categories are classified as irregular bones. They are primarily spongy bone that is covered with a thin layer of compact bone. The vertebrae and some of the bones in the skull are irregular bones.

bones.typesIntro: The four principal types of bones are long, short, flat and irregular.

types.quote: In the body, there are three types of muscle: skeletal (striated), smooth, and cardiac.

heat.quote: Nearly 85 percent of the heat produced in the body is the result of muscle contraction.

output.quote: The normal adult heart pumps about 5 liters of blood every minute throughout life.

sinoatrial.quote: Without any neural stimulation, the sinoatrial node rhythmically initiates impulses 70 to 80 times per minute.

cycle.quote: At a normal heart rate, one cardiac cycle lasts for 0.8 second.

phases.quote: Systole is the contraction phase of the cardiac cycle, and diastole is the relaxation phase.

restingRate.quote: At rest, a heart rate of 60 to 100 beats per minute is normal.

valves.quote: The tricuspid valve separates the right atrium and right ventricle.
The mitral valve separates the left atrium and left ventricle.

pathQuotes.quote: Oxygen-poor blood from the body enters your heart through two large veins called the superior and inferior vena cava.
The pulmonary artery then carries the oxygen-poor blood from your heart to the lungs. Your lungs add oxygen to your blood. The oxygen-rich blood returns to your heart through the pulmonary veins.

categories.label: Normal
categories.text: Less than 120 systolic pressure AND Less than 80 diastolic pressure

categories.label: Elevated
categories.text: 120 to 129 systolic pressure AND Less than 80 diastolic pressure

categories.label: High Blood Pressure Stage 1
categories.text: 130 to 139 systolic pressure OR 80 to 89 diastolic pressure

categories.label: High Blood Pressure Stage 2
categories.text: 140 or higher systolic pressure OR 90 or higher diastolic pressure

categories.label: Hypertensive Crisis
categories.text: Higher than 180 systolic pressure OR Higher than 120 diastolic pressure

volume.quote: In an adult human, blood volume measures about five liters and accounts for eight percent (8%) of the body weight.

plasma.quote: The light yellow fluid at the top is plasma, which makes up about 55% of blood volume.

distribution.label: systemic arteries
distribution.quote: About 10 percent of the total blood volume is in the systemic arterial system at any given time.

distribution.label: systemic capillaries
distribution.quote: About 5 percent of the total blood volume is in the systemic capillaries at any given time.

distribution.label: lungs
distribution.quote: Another 10 percent is in the lungs.

distribution.label: veins
distribution.quote: Almost 70 percent of the total blood volume is in the veins at any given time.

velocity.quote: The rate, or velocity, of blood flow varies inversely with the total cross-sectional area of the blood vessels.

resistance.quote: In blood vessels, most of the resistance is due to vessel diameter.

alveoli.quote: Your lungs have about 150 million alveoli.

breathing.quote: Under normal conditions, the average adult takes 12 to 15 breaths a minute.
